entries.title: Psalms 96:1
segments: Oh sing unto Jehovah a new song: Sing unto Jehovah, all the earth.

entries.title: Psalms 96:2
segments: Sing unto Jehovah, bless his name; Show forth his salvation from day to day.

entries.title: Psalms 96:3
segments: Declare his glory among the nations, His marvellous works among all the peoples.

entries.title: Psalms 96:4
segments: For great is Jehovah, and greatly to be praised: He is to be feared above all gods.

entries.title: Psalms 96:5
segments: For all the gods of the peoples are  idols; But Jehovah made the heavens.

entries.title: Psalms 96:6
segments: Honor and majesty are before him: Strength and beauty are in his sanctuary.

entries.title: Psalms 96:7
segments: Ascribe unto Jehovah, ye kindreds of the peoples, Ascribe unto Jehovah glory and strength.

entries.title: Psalms 96:8
segments: Ascribe unto Jehovah the glory due unto his name: Bring an offering, and come into his courts.

entries.title: Psalms 96:9
segments: Oh worship Jehovah  in holy array: Tremble before him, all the earth.

entries.title: Psalms 96:10
segments: Say among the nations, Jehovah reigneth: The world also is established that it cannot be moved: He will judge the peoples with equity.

entries.title: Psalms 96:11
segments: Let the heavens be glad, and let the earth rejoice; Let the sea roar, and the fulness thereof;

entries.title: Psalms 96:12
segments: Let the field exult, and all that is therein; Then shall all the trees of the wood sing for joy

entries.title: Psalms 96:13
segments: Before Jehovah; for he cometh, For he cometh to judge the earth: He will judge the world with righteousness, And the peoples  with his truth.
